name: Roman Republic
description: The Roman Republic was established in 509 BC and lasted until 27 BC. It was a period of expansion and political development in ancient Rome.

name: Roman Empire
description: The Roman Empire was established in 27 BC and lasted until 476 AD. It was a period of territorial expansion and cultural advancement in Rome.

name: Fall of the Western Roman Empire
description: The Fall of the Western Roman Empire occurred in 476 AD. It marked the end of the ancient Roman civilization and the transition to the Middle Ages.

name: Renaissance
description: The Renaissance was a period of cultural and intellectual rebirth in Europe, including Italy, from the 14th to the 17th century. It brought significant changes in art, literature, and science.

name: Unification of Italy
description: The Unification of Italy occurred in the 19th century, leading to the creation of a unified Italian state. It involved the consolidation of various states and kingdoms under the leadership of figures like Giuseppe Garibaldi and Count Camillo di Cavour.

name: World War I
description: Italy participated in World War I from 1915 to 1918. It initially joined the war alongside the Allies, seeking territorial gains, but faced numerous challenges and casualties.

name: Fascist Era
description: The Fascist Era, led by Benito Mussolini, lasted from 1922 to 1943 in Italy. It was characterized by authoritarian rule, nationalism, and suppression of political opposition.

name: World War II and Liberation
description: Italy was involved in World War II from 1940 to 1945. It initially supported Nazi Germany and Fascist Italy but later switched sides and experienced the liberation from German occupation in 1945.

name: Formation of the European Union
description: The Treaty of Rome was signed in 1957, marking the beginning of the establishment of the European Economic Community (EEC), which eventually evolved into the European Union (EU). Italy was one of the founding members.

name: Modern Italy
description: Since the 20th century, Italy has experienced political, social, and economic changes. It has become a member of the G7, undergone various political shifts, and faced challenges such as economic recessions and migration.
